Perimeter College Advisement

Every Perimeter College student is assigned an academic advisor in the Perimeter College Advisement Center.

Remove Holds

An advisement hold means you must meet with your advisor before you can register for classes.

Schedule an appointment with your advisor through Navigate to have your advisement hold removed.

Clarkston Campus Advisement is located in Building CN, Room 1100. Email: pcadvisement@gsu.edu
